column3: 3C. A power of attorney other than a power
of attorney executed by a state institution shall
be valid, only for a period of five years from
the  date  of  execution,  unless  the  period  of
validity of such power of attorney is specified
in such power of attorney or until such power
of  attorney  is  revoked  or  cancelled  in
accordance with the provisions of section 4.
